# The engine's inventory figures read 461 classes; dev has 503

## Context

Clio's defect-note of 2026-11-20 13:43Z (`c90d3e10`): the engine's class count is wrong in eight places, and nothing generates or checks it. The figures were written on 2026-11-07 (#20545, at `8e1f408d99`). Engine 14's `README.md` goes to npm with the publish on Mon 2026-11-23, so whatever it says then is frozen for the release.

## The Problem

Measured with the method that reproduces the original figures (`git grep -l 'Neo.setupClass(' -- src`; namespaces are the top-level folders under `src/` that hold such a file; addons are those under `src/main/addon/` without `Base.mjs`):

| Figure | Written (at `8e1f408d99`) | `dev` at `5cb81df00a` |
|---|---|---|
| classes | `461` (the method gives 460) | 503 |
| namespaces | `39` | 44 |
| main-thread addons | `38` | 39 |
| form field types, layouts, dock classes | `26`, `8`, `42` | unchanged |

The mirrors: `README.md:110` and `:176`; `apps/portal/view/home/parts/AudienceDoors.mjs:125`; `learn/README.md:3` and `:29`; `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md:3` and `:12`; `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md:10`; `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json:81`; the namespace count alone at `seo.json:177` and `learn/benefits/body/Features.md:4`. `seo.json:14` says `460+`, a floor that stays true.

The window added 42 class files in eleven days (board 11, gantt 10, desktop 10, timeline 8, scheduler 2, seven others). Any figure a person types goes stale within the release it describes.

## The Architectural Reality

- No generator and no lint own these figures; `AudienceDoors.spec.mjs` couples only the README and the home's door text.
- `publish.mjs prepare` already stamps release facts (the version) into the release commit, and npm publishes the README from that commit.
- The copy around the figures is identity copy (ADR 0018) with its own steward; this ticket changes figures, not wording.

## The Fix

1. `buildScripts/release/engineInventory.mjs` (beside `analyzeClosedSinceRelease.mjs`, the other cut-time script): computes the figures from `src` with the method above, and holds one table of mirrors (file, pattern, figure). Without flags it prints the figures and every mirror that differs; `--write` rewrites those mirrors.
2. A unit spec: the computation on a fixture tree, and every mirror pattern matching exactly once on the real files, so a reworded sentence fails with a pointer to the table instead of silently dropping out of it. It does not compare figures with `src`, so adding a class never turns a pull request red.
3. Run `--write` now: 503, 44, 39.
4. Add the run to the cut on #21033: `--write` on the release candidate, so the README npm freezes carries that release's figures.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `node buildScripts/util/engineInventory.mjs` prints classes, namespaces and addons, and reproduces 460, 39 and 38 when pointed at a checkout of `8e1f408d99`.
- [ ] AC-2: every listed mirror carries the figures of `dev` at the PR's head.
- [ ] AC-3: the unit spec fails when a mirror's sentence no longer matches its pattern (red on a reworded copy, shown in the PR), and passes on the PR's head.
- [ ] AC-4: #21033's cut steps name the `--write` run on the release candidate.

## Out of Scope

- Rewording the copy around the figures, and a floor phrasing such as `500+` (identity copy; its steward's call on #20682).
- Running the stamp inside `publish.mjs prepare` itself: a follow-up after the cut, not a change to the release path two days before it.
- Figures that did not drift (`26`, `8`, `42`, `100,000`, `40,000+`).

## Avoided Traps

- **A spec that compares the typed figure with `src`.** Every pull request that adds a class would go red on files it never touched.
- **Fixing the eleven numbers by hand only.** The same drift returns before the next cut.
